o6.title: Fast code: FIFO stock ledger (small)
Fast code: Prefix matches under edits (medium)
o6.fast:
def solve(task):
    s = list(task['text']); n = len(s); out = []
    for op in task['ops']:
        if op[0] == 'set':
            s[op[1]] = op[2]; continue
        i, j = op[1], op[2]
        if i == j: out.append(n - i); continue
        top = n - max(i, j)
        step = 16  # galloping, then binary search, on slice comparisons done in C
        lo = 0
        while lo + step <= top and s[i + lo:i + lo + step] == s[j + lo:j + lo + step]:
            lo += step; step *= 2
        hi = min(top, lo + step)
        while lo < hi:
            mid = (lo + hi + 1) // 2
            if s[i + lo:i + mid] == s[j + lo:j + mid]: lo = mid
            else: hi = mid - 1
        out.append(lo)
    return out
